name: Summer Session Courses for High School Students (UVA)
org: University of Virginia, Summer and Special Academic Programs
what_you_do: Take a real UVA summer college class with UVA students. You pick from 1000 or 2000 level Arts and Sciences classes. None need earlier classes.
who_can_apply: Rising high school juniors and seniors with strong academic records. The page gives no GPA cutoff. Housing is not provided and high school students cannot use UVA housing unless they are in UVA Advance.
pay_detail: 2027 tuition listed per credit hour: $499 for Virginia residents or $1,841 for non-residents, plus a one-time comprehensive fee ($516 or $576) for on-Grounds courses. The page does not say which rate high schoolers pay, so ask the office.
duration: One course per session. 2027 sessions: May 17 to June 11, June 14 to July 9, July 12 to Aug 5
deadline_text: No deadline or dates were stated on the program page.
how_to_apply: Send the Online Non-Degree Student form and choose Summer Session. Send a Medical Consent Form for Minors signed by a parent. Ask your counselor or principal for a Secondary School Report and your transcript. Contact summer@virginia.edu or 434-924-3371.
notes: Families set up their own housing. For a live in option, see the separate UVA Advance card.
